name: Lexus GS F
h1: Lexus GS F: performance, engines and what owners say

nhtsa.note: NHTSA has no separate GS F name in its complaint files. GS F owners file under GS, which also covers the GS 350, GS 200t / 300 and GS 450h, so these counts include those versions.

gens.tag: 467 hp V8 five-seat sport sedan; rear-drive, 8-speed automatic, torque vectoring differential.

variants.name: GS F
variants.what: 2017 added Linear Adaptive Variable Suspension; the V8 output stayed the same.

2UR-GSE.name: Lexus 2UR-GSE
facts: 467 hp / 389 lb-ft in the GS F
Titanium intake and exhaust valves, forged connecting rods

issues.x: On some 2016–2018 GS Fs (and 2015–2018 RC Fs, 2018 LC 500s), a damper in one of the two high-pressure fuel pumps could crack the pump cover and leak fuel.
issues.fix: Dealer replaces the high-pressure fuel pumps for free (NHTSA 18V-107).

issues.x: NHTSA recall 26V-222 covers 2015–2022 Lexus RC, 2016–2020 GS and 2022 IS vehicles: the low-pressure fuel pump in the tank may fail, which can stall the engine.
issues.fix: Dealer replaces the fuel pump for free (NHTSA 26V-222). Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
